gp180.choicePolicy: Since the source is a ukulele (acoustic/nylon string), this rig focuses on simulating a clean, fingerpicked acoustic sound using available clean patches and room ambience. The tone will be highly stylized to mimic nylon strings.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A bright, clean signal chain utilizing compression for attack definition, followed by a classic Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) paired with a small cab (US 2x12) and subtle Room reverb to capture the gentle, natural acoustic feel of the ukulele.

blocks.purpose: Clean up any background hum or noise inherent in the recording/simulation.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the initial attack and sustain, mimicking the plucked nature of nylon strings.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is used to simulate the percussive pluck/attack characteristic of acoustic instruments.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No drive or distortion is required for this clean acoustic tone.
blocks.gap: N/A

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, clean, and articulate tone suitable for acoustic simulations.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best available model to simulate the clarity of an acoustic guitar/ukulele sound without excessive coloration.

blocks.purpose: Select a small, bright cabinet to maintain the intimate and non-boomy sound of the ukulele.
blocks.gap: A smaller cab is necessary to prevent the tone from becoming too large or muddy for the source material.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the high end and slightly scoop the low-mids to enhance clarity and simulate nylon string brightness.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is crucial for simulating the specific frequency response of a ukulele/nylon string instrument.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. Wah effects are explicitly avoided by the source material.
blocks.gap: N/A

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle, natural room ambience without sounding artificial or overly wet.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is the best choice for simulating a gentle, natural acoustic space as requested.

blocks.purpose: Final output level adjustment.
blocks.gap: N/A

warnings: The source material is a ukulele (nylon string acoustic), not an electric guitar. This rig uses clean patches and EQ to simulate the bright, plucked character of nylon strings.
Due to the limitations of simulating a specific non-electric instrument, the tone will be highly stylized and may not capture the full nuance of the original recording.

improvements.summary: The current setup is already heavily optimized for acoustic simulation. The primary improvement should focus on refining the cabinet/IR to better match the intimate, non-electric source tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance intimacy and natural acoustic sound capture.
